description: This file defines the GeminiApi class implementing the BaseLlmApi interface for interacting with Google's Generative Language API, including methods for chat completion, stream handling, and request body conversion.

classes.name: GeminiApi
classes.description: Implements the BaseLlmApi interface to interact with Google's Gemini language model API, providing chat and streaming functionalities.

methods.name: _oaiPartToGeminiPart
methods.description: Converts OpenAI chat content parts to Gemini chat content parts.

methods.name: _convertBody
methods.description: Converts OpenAI chat completion parameters into Gemini API request body format.

methods.name: chatCompletionNonStream
methods.description: Performs a non-streaming chat completion request, accumulating response chunks.

methods.name: handleStreamResponse
methods.description: Processes streaming response chunks from Gemini API, yielding chat chunks and usage info.

methods.name: chatCompletionStream
methods.description: Initiates a streaming chat completion request and yields response chunks.

methods.name: completionNonStream
methods.description: Not implemented method for non-streaming completion.

methods.name: completionStream
methods.description: Not implemented method for streaming completion.

methods.name: fimStream
methods.description: Not implemented method for FIM stream.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Not implemented method to list models.
